authority: A locator ledger, not an authority. A row records the repository-relative paths a closed issue's own body names; it does not decide whether the closure was correct, whether the artifact is any good, or whether anything downstream of it ran.
curation_rule: artifacts[] holds only paths that appear literally in the issue body and that the body requires this repository to carry. A body that names no such path gets an empty list and a note saying why, so NO_PATH_NAMED stays distinct from a pass. A path named as material that must be absent is never recorded as a required artifact.
